title: Communication, Learning, and Bargaining Breakdown: An Empirical Analysis
authors: Matthew Backus; Thomas Blake; Jett Pettus; Steven Tadelis
eligible_reason: eBay Germany enabled Best Offer messaging on a single date for desktop buyers; main_results.do estimates pre-post and DiD regressions (reg success_dummy post byr_offer_desktop postdesk [controls]) comparing desktop with mobile threads, without unit FE, plus IV (ivreg2) of success on message use instrumented by postdesk. Single treatment date; no staggered adoption.
design_notes: Stata and Python. Thread-level Best Offer data (de_offs9.dta, de_messages.dta) are confidential and not shipped; only German weather data are included.
data_files_note: README: 'no eBay data can be made publicly available'.
data_provenance_note: eBay data confidential; only the weather control file is included.
screener_notes: Screened from README and code. Common-date desktop vs mobile DiD and IV; data not shipped.
